finding.title: Replace profile_picker_screen.dart's private rename/delete dialogs with the canonical editProfileFlow/deleteProfileFlow
finding.rule: AX-2 (no hardcoded user-facing strings) / Fowler duplication

evidence.quote:
? 'This is your only profile. Deleting '
                      '"${profile.displayName}" will erase every track, '

await repo.deleteProfile(profile.id, allowLast: isLast);
    final sel = ref.read(selectedProfileIdProvider) ?? -1;

finding.why: profile_picker_screen.dart implements its own `_showRenameDialog`/`_showDeleteDialog` instead of reusing the canonical `editProfileFlow`/`deleteProfileFlow` from profile_edit_delete_actions.dart (which manage_learners_screen.dart correctly delegates to, per its own 'WS1.consolidate' comment). The duplicate is inferior on two fronts: (1) the last-profile branch of its delete dialog hardcodes English sentences ('Delete your only profile?', the erase-everything body, 'Delete anyway') instead of using ARB keys the sibling flow already has (deleteProfileLastTitle/Body/Confirm) — any Hebrew-locale user with exactly one profile who tries to delete it sees raw untranslated English, breaking the app's EN/HE parity invariant; (2) after `await repo.deleteProfile(...)` it touches `ref` with no `mounted` guard (the sibling `_showRenameDialog` in the same file does guard with `if (mounted) ref.invalidate(...)`), risking a post-dispose WidgetRef use if the user navigates away during the multi-table cascade delete.
finding.recommendation: Delete `_showRenameDialog`/`_showManageSheet`'s rename+delete branches from profile_picker_screen.dart and call `editProfileFlow`/`deleteProfileFlow` from profile_edit_delete_actions.dart instead, matching manage_learners_screen.dart.
acceptance_criteria: profile_picker_screen.dart's long-press menu invokes editProfileFlow/deleteProfileFlow (or an equivalent single canonical implementation) rather than private duplicates
A Locale('he') widget test opens the delete dialog on an account with exactly one profile and asserts no raw-English literal renders
